name: cursor-cli
description:
Cursor CLI is the official command-line interface for the Cursor AI code editor ecosystem. It provides terminal-based developer tools to interact with Cursor's AI models, search codebases, and manage background coding sessions.

Features:
- Direct command-line interaction with advanced AI programming models
- Fast repository indexing and codebase-wide semantic search capabilities
- Seamless terminal workflows for asking questions and generating code diffs
- Integration with local developer environments and CI/CD pipelines
- Rapid access to project context and documentation summaries
